rationale: The agent authenticated the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account, then retrieved user and order details. It identified the delivered order as eligible for returns, correctly listed items, and confirmed the user’s intent and refund destination before performing the return. The tool call returned the order updated to “return requested” with the correct item IDs and PayPal method. The agent then provided an accurate refund breakdown that matches the item prices from the tools, without fabricating details. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account, and no writes occurred without explicit confirmation.
